diagram_previews.alt: Oblique sketch of the square pyramid with base ABCD (A front left, B front right, C back right, D back left) and apex E. Base edges AB and AD are labelled 12; the lateral edges are labelled AE root 193, BE 11 and DE 13. The hidden edges BC, CD and CE are dashed. A red dashed height runs from E down to the foot H on the base and is labelled h.
